caveats: Fixed cosmology (TNG fiducial) across the entire 30-param Sobol suite -- motivates Appendix A
TNG-only amplitude for all bias/cost numbers; the dimensionality claim (~2 templates) is the argued-robust/general part, corroborated independently by Lin+2026's latent analysis
ell range / map-resolution limits: ell capped at 1.5e4 in the transfer-function ensemble (CIC aliasing dominates above this); Fisher analyses use ell_max in {2000,3000,5000}
Step-4 self-calibration CORRECTION: use lightcone_selfcal.py's corrected result, never the original rank-1 bias_tomography.png claim
Statistical-only/2-param significance (no h, ns, IA, photo-z marginalisation) makes the sigma-significance numbers optimistic; only the dS8 magnitudes are argued robust
Capstone Fisher result is shear-auto only, Gaussian/linear covariance, assumes P_hydro=P_dmo*T^2 separability
BCemu's analytic-model coverage was computed varying only its dominant log10Mc parameter -- a lower bound on its true coverage
HMcode-AGN was not included in the Step-5 analytic-model comparison (toolchain not installed)

Held-out (even/odd) N=2 validation number (<=0.08 sigma) has no saved artifact on disk -- sourced from WORKLOG text only, unlike the other headline numbers which were independently re-verified against saved .npz files
No WORKLOG entry exists for the full-likelihood Robertson-style shear forecast despite the brief instructing to search WORKLOG for it -- numbers recovered directly from on-disk .npz outputs instead
Suite size was in flux across the campaign (96->99->216->237->253 runs); different results in this dossier were computed at different points -- canonical final count is 253/256
